verdict.rationale: Lovable's Git sync/GitHub integration provides version control and PR-based review of generated code changes (branches, pull requests, working locally), which covers versioning and review of the app's automation logic. However, there is no explicit evidence of a built-in rollback/checkpoint mechanism within Lovable itself (e.g., reverting to a prior generated version), so rollback relies on standard git tooling outside the product. Missing for 10: explicit in-product rollback/checkpoint feature, evidence of reviewing/approving automation-specific changes (vs. general code), and independent confirmation that version history works reliably in practice.
